race.comment: DELIGHTFUL JOURNEY (1) will be taking up a forward position and while the recent form doesn't look great, there are some reasons. Perhaps the biggest of them is he much prefers a dry track. So assuming we get a good surface, watch for a quick turn in form. SPIRIT ANGEL (11) does have to be well respected. She has run some good races this campaign without nailing the win. Does get back and find the line. PRESERVATOR (10) only ran last week and runs similarly each time. Should get a soft run all the way. Has backed up well in the past. SCANDOVAL (6) ran best two ago and that was over the mile. Suspect the last effort was over that bit too far. The betting is a guide. UP AND UNDER (3) also drops back in journey. Not had much luck at the gates.
